moments.title: The Hundred heats up this weekend
moments.blurb: Cricket's 100-ball competition continues with key matches across the UK this weekend, building towards next week's final.

angles.name: Weekend Matches Build-Up
angles.copy: Huge weekend for The Hundred! MI London and Trent Rockets clash at The Oval, while Southern Brave take on Manchester Super Giants. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Local Team Focus (Welsh Fire)
angles.copy: All eyes on the Welsh Fire this weekend in The Hundred! They face Southern Brave tomorrow, then Sunrisers Leeds on Sunday. Can they ignite their campaign?

angles.name: Road to the Final
angles.copy: The Hundred Final is just over a week away! Every match this weekend is crucial as teams battle for a spot at Lord's on August 16th. Don't miss the action!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has now spent a record-breaking 20th non-consecutive week at UK Number 1, extending their lead as the longest-running chart-topper ever.

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just notched an incredible 20th week at UK Number 1. A truly iconic chart run!

angles.name: The Power of a Duet
angles.copy: 20 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is proving the power of a perfect duet. What's your favourite collaboration right now?

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: No stopping 'Rein Me In'! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the Official Singles Chart. Can anyone knock them off the top?

moments.title: Ariana Grande reigns albums chart, hits singles Top 5
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's album 'Petal' is Number 1 on the Official Albums Chart, while she also has two tracks in the Top 5 of the singles chart.

angles.name: Album & Singles Domination
angles.copy: Queen of the charts! Ariana Grande's 'Petal' is the UK's Number 1 album, PLUS she has two songs in the singles Top 5. Total domination!

angles.name: New Album Buzz
angles.copy: Have you streamed Ariana Grande's Number 1 album 'Petal' yet? It's flying high, alongside 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' and 'Petal' in the Top 5 singles.

moments.title: Rebellion Festival takes over Blackpool
moments.blurb: The iconic Rebellion Festival, celebrating punk and alternative music, is currently underway in Blackpool's Winter Gardens, running until August 9th.

angles.name: Punk Rock Weekend
angles.copy: Blackpool is buzzing! Rebellion Festival is in full swing, bringing the best of punk and alternative music to the Winter Gardens until Sunday. Who's there?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Earplugs in, mosh pit ready! Rebellion Festival is providing the ultimate punk rock escape this weekend. Catch the last day tomorrow!

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut in London
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated Roots Picnic festival makes its anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend, August 8-9, blending hip hop, music, culture, and community.

angles.name: London Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Roots Picnic lands in London this weekend! Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting the international debut of this epic hip hop and culture festival. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Hip Hop & Culture
angles.copy: From Philly to London! The Roots Picnic brings its unique blend of music, culture, and community to the UK for the first time ever, August 8-9. Get ready for the vibes!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Iron Maiden's Bruce Dickinson
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden frontman, airline pilot, and author Bruce Dickinson celebrates his 68th birthday today, August 7th.

angles.name: Metal Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the legendary Bruce Dickinson of Iron Maiden! What's your favourite Maiden track with his iconic vocals?

angles.name: More Than Music
angles.copy: He's a rock icon, pilot, and author! Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Iron Maiden's multi-talented frontman, Bruce Dickinson.

moments.title: Happy 49th to DJ Samantha Ronson
moments.blurb: English DJ and singer-songwriter Samantha Ronson, known for her energetic live performances, turns 49 today, August 7th.

angles.name: DJ Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 49th birthday to the fantastic DJ and singer-songwriter Samantha Ronson! What's your favourite track to hear her spin?

angles.name: Music & Nights
angles.copy: From spinning at high-profile events to being signed to Roc-A-Fella, happy 49th birthday to the energetic Samantha Ronson!

moments.title: Happy 76th to Country legend Rodney Crowell
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American country music artist and songwriter Rodney Crowell, known for hits like 'Diamonds & Dirt', celebrates his 76th birthday today, August 7th.

angles.name: Country Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to country music icon Rodney Crowell! His album 'Diamonds & Dirt' featured five consecutive #1 hits. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Songwriting Master
angles.copy: A true legend of country music, happy 76th birthday to the incredible songwriter Rodney Crowell!

moments.title: Summer Holidays still in full swing
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are continuing across England, Wales, and Scotland this week, with many families enjoying their breaks before the new academic year.

angles.name: Holiday Fun
angles.copy: Mid-August means summer holidays are still in full swing for many! What are your plans for the last few weeks of freedom before school goes back?

angles.name: Family Getaways
angles.copy: Sunshine and smiles! With school holidays continuing, many families are making the most of the summer. Where's your favourite UK staycation spot?

moments.title: Community Shield next weekend in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will take place next Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The 2026/27 football season officially kicks off next Sunday! Manchester City vs Arsenal in the Community Shield at Principality Stadium, Cardiff. Who's winning the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosting
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage next weekend! Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield as Man City face Arsenal. Get ready for a huge day of football in Wales!

angles.name: Early Season Prediction
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City for the Community Shield next weekend! A taste of the Premier League season to come. What's your score prediction?

moments.title: Medicine Festival begins next week
moments.blurb: The Medicine Festival, a not-for-profit gathering celebrating indigenous wisdom, live music, and community, starts next Thursday, August 12th, in Dorset.

angles.name: Conscious Festival
angles.copy: Looking for something different? Medicine Festival, celebrating indigenous wisdom, live music, and wellness, kicks off in Dorset next Thursday!

angles.name: Dorset Event
angles.copy: Next week, Dorset hosts the Medicine Festival – a unique gathering focused on community, culture, and music. Perfect for a mindful escape!
